list.title: List tickets
list.description: Lists the support tickets with number, customer, subject, status and assignee. Use it to find a ticket when only its topic is known.
list.status: Only tickets in this status. Leave out to list all of them.
list.answers: The matching tickets, each with number, customer, subject, status, assignee and reply count.

open.title: Open ticket
open.description: Opens a ticket in the workbench and returns its details, including the customer's message.
open.answers: The ticket: number, customer, subject, body, status, assignee and its replies.

assign.title: Assign ticket
assign.description: Assigns a ticket to a team member. An open ticket moves to in progress.
assign.to: Who takes the ticket: dana, lee or sam.

reply.title: Reply to ticket
reply.description: Sends a reply to the customer on a ticket. The person at the keyboard confirms it first.
reply.text: The reply text as the customer will read it.
reply.answers: The ticket after the reply was sent.

status.title: Set ticket status
status.description: Moves a ticket to open, in progress or done.
status.status: The new status: open, in progress or done.
